methodology.source: Independent reference generator executed with Python arbitrary-precision int; no product JavaScript, parser or implementation was read to derive expected numbers.
methodology.money: Canonical decimal strings converted by removing decimal point; input scale determines minor unit. Exact integer sums. All monetary/minor/geometric numerator fields remain strings if unbounded.
methodology.filtering: ledgerRecords includes DB-only deleted metadata; state.records is the independently expected native month/currency/nondeleted selection. UI chart starts from state.records and includes kind=expense only.
methodology.basisPoints: For each group: quotient,remainder=divmod(minor*10000,total). Allocate 10000-sum(quotients) points by remainder descending, key ascending. Reallocation is not repeated after Others aggregation.
methodology.sort: Group minor descending, ASCII key ascending; null key ~uncategorized. More than6groups => first5 + ~other comprising the rest, kept last even if its sum is larger than a preceding slice.
methodology.geometry: Q=1000000000; sorted visual cumulative endpoint=floor(Q*cumulativeMinor/total). Start is preceding endpoint. Last endpoint Q. No minimum width and no independent rounding of slice widths.
methodology.independentChecksExecuted: All 13 cases: sum category minors=total; sum bps=10000 if total>0 else0; visual money/bps conserved; widths sum=Q if positive else0; last endpoint Q; canonical amount scale checked.
methodology.limits: Synthetic reference data only. This does not execute or validate Android/UI. Invalid DTO fixtures expect a visible chart-unavailable state, without zero replacement or partial totals; no specific internal error code is imposed.
